summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Sentinel-Ops + RootCause-AI portfolio MVP. All 13 backend pytest cases passed (health/models, sentinel telemetry, sentinel chat with gpt-5.2 and claude-sonnet-4.5, rootcause analyze + history + 400 short-input). Frontend Landing, Sentinel-Ops dashboard (KPIs/charts/anomaly feed/services grid/log viewer/AI chat), and RootCause-AI (load sample → analyze → RCA card + history) all worked end-to-end. Cross-page navigation works.

issues: Recharts emits multiple console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial mount. Charts still render correctly. Likely fixable by giving ResponsiveContainer a minWidth/minHeight or wrapping parent with explicit height. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Suppress Recharts ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on Sentinel-Ops by setting explicit min height or aspect on chart wrappers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~487-line file; acceptable for MVP but consider splitting routers (sentinel/rootcause/llm) and helpers into modules if it grows past ~700 lines.
call_llm imports emergentintegrations inside the function on every request — fine functionally, but module-level import would avoid repeated import cost.
_extract_json regex r'\{.*\}' is greedy across the whole text; works for clean LLM output but could mis-match if multiple JSON blocks appear. Acceptable for current behavior.
RCA history endpoint has no pagination cursor (only limit). Fine for portfolio scope.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider lifespan handler. Non-blocking.
All MongoDB reads correctly project out `_id` — good.
test_credentials: n/a — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Tests created several rca_history docs prefixed with 'TEST_' titles and one sentinel_chat session. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~35s and parametrizes LLM tests over gpt-5.2 + claude-sonnet-4.5 only (gemini intentionally skipped to save credits). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is read from /app/frontend/.env. All 3 routes (/, /sentinel, /rootcause) verified visually. Recharts width(-1) warnings are the only console noise observed.
